title: GG Afrikan Eleganz
description: A live WordPress e-commerce storefront I designed, built, and run — selling African-inspired elegance to real customers.
long_description: GG Afrikan Eleganz is a fully operational online store I built and manage end to end on WordPress and WooCommerce — product catalog, secure checkout, shipping, and branding all included. Beyond the tech, it's a real revenue-generating business: a hands-on exercise in turning a build into something that actually pays for itself. The storefront is designed for a clean, trustworthy shopping experience that turns browsers into buyers.
how_to_use: Visit ggafrikaneleganz.com to browse the catalog, add items to your cart, and check out securely. Everything from product pages to payment is live and fully functional.

title: LaunchPad
description: An AI business-development platform that takes founders from idea to funded — branding, market research, investor matching, equity deals, and payments in one workspace.
long_description: LaunchPad gives entrepreneurs a single place to build a business: a conversational AI advisor fills out a 70+ field profile, generates branding and market analysis, and curates real funding resources, while investors discover verified businesses, make equity offers, and negotiate deals that flow straight into Stripe checkout. It's built squarely around helping people fund themselves and create economic opportunity. Architecturally it's a 10-blueprint Flask app with a multi-provider AI cascade (Gemini, then Claude, then an open-source fallback) and a Material Design UI.
how_to_use: Sign up as a founder to build your business profile with the AI advisor, run the planning tools (SWOT, risk, action roadmap), and list equity for investment. Sign up as an investor to discover businesses, make offers, and complete deals through Stripe.

title: TicketLeader
description: A fair-queue ticketing platform with a 3D stadium seat viewer, multi-layer bot detection, and a trust-score queue that rewards real fans.
long_description: TicketLeader reimagines the ticket-buying experience: an interactive 80,000-seat 3D stadium lets fans see their exact view, accessibility routing, and parking before they buy, while multi-layer bot detection (behavioral tracking, AI trivia gates, and WebAuthn biometrics) keeps scalper bots out. Fans climb a Bronze-to-Platinum trust rank by engaging while they wait, so humans — not bots — get the seats. The result is a fairer market where real fans pay fair prices, built on React, Three.js, and Socket.IO.
how_to_use: Open the live queue, join the waiting room, and earn trust by playing trivia and polls. Explore the 3D stadium to preview any seat's sightline, accessibility route, and parking before purchasing.

title: CryptoBase
description: A privacy-preserving DeFi app for lending, trading, and risk monitoring — with zero-knowledge proofs that verify your position without exposing the numbers.
long_description: CryptoBase is a Flask and Web3 decentralized-finance platform where users lend, borrow, and trade on-chain while a risk engine watches their health factor in real time. Its standout is a Midnight-network privacy layer: zero-knowledge circuits prove a position is over-collateralized without ever publishing the collateral or debt amounts. The backend never holds private keys — every fund-moving transaction is returned unsigned for the user's own wallet to approve.
how_to_use: Connect a MetaMask wallet, deposit testnet collateral, and borrow or trade against it. The dashboard shows your live health factor and risk class, and the privacy page lets you attest your position with a zero-knowledge proof.

title: Frontier Finance
description: A western-themed personal-finance and trading platform with AI savings advice, LSTM stock prediction, OCR statement scanning, and a voice advisor.
long_description: Frontier Finance wraps a serious finance toolkit in a frontier aesthetic: upload a bank statement and OCR parses and categorizes your spending, an AI layer suggests tailored savings, and a TensorFlow LSTM ensemble predicts next-day stock moves with full technical charts and simulated trading. 'Frontier Frank' answers money questions out loud via voice AI, and an endless-runner mini-game keeps it playful. It's aimed at helping everyday people understand investing and take control of their finances, built on Next.js and FastAPI with graceful AI fallbacks.
how_to_use: Log in, upload a financial document to auto-parse your spending, and review AI savings suggestions. Search any stock ticker for an LSTM price prediction and charts, simulate buys and sells, or just ask Frontier Frank a money question by voice.

title: Vocalytics
description: An AI public-speaking coach that analyzes speech pace, filler words, and posture in real time — built to help people, including those with disabilities, become stronger speakers.
long_description: Vocalytics turns a webcam and mic into a personal speaking coach: real-time analysis of pace and filler words, MediaPipe posture detection, recorded practice sessions with historical tracking, and AI coaching feedback with spoken responses. It was built with accessibility at its core — helping people, including those with disabilities, develop confident communication skills. Built on Flask, OpenCV, MediaPipe, and Google Generative AI.
how_to_use: Allow camera and microphone access, then start a practice session. Speak as you would in a real talk — Vocalytics tracks your pace, filler words, and posture live, then gives AI coaching feedback you can review and compare against past sessions.

title: SOS Moderators
description: An AI-assisted Reddit moderation platform — spam filtering, trust scoring, and a co-pilot that answers questions about your own subreddit's data.
long_description: SOS Moderators is a full moderation suite that runs inside Reddit, scoring every post for spam, maintaining a 0–1000 community trust system, and giving overworked volunteer moderators an AI co-pilot grounded in their own data. It's built to make online communities healthier and safer without burning out the humans who run them — first-time offenders get a guided recovery path instead of a silent removal. Under the hood: real-time scoring, shadow-audit keyword testing, anti-raid detection, and a Redis-backed dashboard.
how_to_use: Install SOS Moderators on your subreddit through the Reddit Developer Platform, then open the Dashboard from the subreddit menu. Tune thresholds and spam keywords in the Config UI, and ask the Coach tab plain-English questions about your community's data.

title: Vireo
description: An environmental and disaster-relief platform that maps real-time impact data and rallies communities around conservation and cleanup.
long_description: Vireo brings people together around environmental action: an interactive world map surfaces real-time climate and air-quality data, a carbon-footprint calculator turns lifestyle choices into concrete reduction steps, and a community hub lets users organize and join relief and cleanup events. It's built for tangible social and environmental impact, on a Python and Streamlit stack with live data APIs.
how_to_use: Explore the impact dashboard to see live environmental data for any location, calculate your carbon footprint for personalized reduction tips, and join or create cleanup and relief events on the community page.

title: Spotify Music Analytics
description: A machine-learning dashboard that analyzed 99,594 artists to predict hit songs, forecast popularity, and estimate revenue.
long_description: This full-stack analytics platform processes a large Spotify dataset, classifies songs into performance tiers, and trains Random Forest models to predict an artist's next-hit probability, popularity trajectory, and revenue. A React dashboard makes it explorable — searchable, sortable artist tables and detailed profiles enriched with live Spotify data. It pairs real data-science rigor with a clean, interactive UX.
how_to_use: Browse the artist dashboard, sort by metrics like hit rate, revenue, or predicted tier, and open any artist to see their analytics, ML predictions, audio-feature charts, and full song catalog.

title: FINU
description: A financial-education platform built to give underserved communities the investing and stock-market literacy they were never taught.
long_description: FINU is a web app aimed at closing the financial-literacy gap: interactive graphing simulators teach market dynamics and investing principles through hands-on practice, with personalized, approachable guidance. The mission is direct social impact — giving people who were never taught about money the tools to start building wealth. Built with Django and a Python data and ML stack.
how_to_use: Create an account for tailored guidance, then work through the graphing simulators to learn how markets move and how investing decisions play out over time.

title: Basketball GM Rating System
description: A rating engine that generates historically accurate Basketball GM leagues and draft classes for every NBA season from 1950 to 2026.
long_description: This tool scrapes real Basketball Reference stats and converts them into Basketball GM ratings using percentile-based formulas across 15 skill attributes, blending season and career data for realistic results. It produces era-accurate game settings — pace, salary caps, three-point tendencies — and full draft classes back to the BAA era. It's drop-in content for the community of a popular free browser game, built as a clean, CLI-driven pipeline.
how_to_use: Run the CLI to generate a full league for any season (e.g. python main.py generate-league 2024), swap in historical teams, add individual players, or build career-aware draft classes. Load the resulting JSON directly into Basketball GM.

title: Football GM Leagues
description: Historically accurate Football GM rosters and draft classes, plus deep season-by-season and career analytics reports.
long_description: A companion data project for the viral Football GM browser game: curated league files spanning many seasons, paired with generated yearly and career reports that rank players, teams, positional units, and draft-class strength. It turns raw league JSON into readable scouting and all-time analytics that players can explore or build leagues from.
how_to_use: Load the base league JSON files into Football GM to play historical seasons, or open the yearly and career report text files to explore rankings — search the section markers (Y1, C1, etc.) to jump to a category.

title: CoviDash
description: A real-time COVID-19 dashboard mapping global case data on a dark-themed interactive map.
long_description: CoviDash visualizes pandemic data worldwide — color-coded risk markers for cities, states, and countries on a Leaflet map, refreshed every 24 hours from Johns Hopkins/disease.sh and CDC sources, with per-100k infection rates and global statistics. A public-health awareness tool built with Flask and a clean, accessible dark UI.
how_to_use: Open the dashboard and explore the map — click any marker for local case details, or read the global stats panel for totals, risk distribution, and infection rates. Data refreshes automatically every 24 hours.

title: Database Visualizer
description: A Flask app that connects to any SQLite database and auto-generates interactive visualizations — no code required.
long_description: The Database Visualizer lets anyone point at a SQLite file and instantly get an intuitive summary: it inspects column types and auto-builds the right charts (bar, histogram, line, scatter, box) with Plotly, plus filtering and custom SQL. It makes data exploration accessible to people who don't write queries.
how_to_use: Upload a SQLite database or point to one on the server, pick a table to view its data, then open the dashboard for auto-generated charts. Use the filter panel to narrow results or run your own SQL in the custom query tab.

title: Web Summarizer
description: A Django web tool that scrapes any site and pulls back its metadata and images for a quick at-a-glance analysis.
long_description: Web Summarizer takes a URL and extracts a site's metadata and imagery using Selenium and BeautifulSoup, presenting it through a clean, responsive interface. It's a practical productivity tool for quickly understanding or auditing a webpage without digging through source.
how_to_use: Enter any website URL and Web Summarizer fetches and displays its metadata and images, ready to scan or download.

title: Weather App
description: A clean, responsive Flask app that returns real-time weather for any city, with temperature-based color themes.
long_description: A simple, polished weather app built on Flask and the OpenWeatherMap API: search any city worldwide and see temperature, wind, humidity, and pressure, with the interface shifting color based on conditions for instant visual feedback. A focused exercise in responsive design and clean API integration.
how_to_use: Type any city name and submit to see its current weather — temperature, wind, humidity, and pressure — with colors that adapt to how hot or cold it is.

title: Image Filter Studio
description: A desktop image editor with a full filter suite, basic editing tools, and side-by-side before/after export.
long_description: A Python desktop app (Tkinter, OpenCV, and PIL) for applying filters — grayscale, sepia, edge detection, vignette, brightness/contrast and more — plus crop, rotate, flip, and multi-format export. Designed with an intuitive GUI so non-technical users can edit images without touching code.
how_to_use: Upload or drag in an image, pick filters and adjustments from the side panel, use the crop/rotate/flip tools as needed, then export in your chosen format — or save a before/after comparison.

title: Expense Tracker
description: A zero-dependency CLI for tracking expenses, income, budgets, and recurring transactions to manage personal finances.
long_description: A personal-finance tool built entirely on Python's standard library: log expenses and income, set category budgets, automate recurring transactions, and view financial statistics — all from the command line, with data stored in local JSON. Built to make staying on top of your own money simple and frictionless.
how_to_use: Run the launcher, enter your name, currency, and country on first run, then use the menu to add expenses and income, set budgets, and view statistics. Recurring transactions are created automatically each time you start it.

title: ToDo CLI
description: A lightweight command-line to-do list that reads and writes tasks from a JSON store.
long_description: A simple, fast CLI productivity tool for managing tasks without leaving the terminal — add, list, complete, and delete tasks persisted to JSON. A clean exercise in argument handling and file-backed state.
how_to_use: Run python todo.py, then use the commands: add (task), list, completed, complete (id), delete (id), and help.

title: Blob Bros
description: A Mario-style platformer built in Python with a custom physics engine, multiple enemy types, and collectibles.
long_description: Blob Bros is a classic side-scrolling platformer made with Python and the Arcade library — gravity, collision detection, four distinct enemy AIs, a scoring system, and TMX-based custom levels. A from-scratch dive into game physics, state management, and asset and animation pipelines.
how_to_use: Run python main.py to start. Use the arrow keys to move, spacebar to jump, and jump on enemies to defeat them while collecting coins for points. Press F1 for debug mode.

title: Slot Machine
description: A slot-machine game built in Python with a Tkinter interface — spin, win, and track your balance.
long_description: A graphical slot-machine game made with Python, Tkinter, and threading. A fun exercise in GUI state, animation timing, and game logic.
how_to_use: Install Python and the required libraries, then run main.py to launch the game and start spinning.

title: Dino Shooter
description: A Python remake of the offline dinosaur game — with a twist: the dino can shoot targets for score.
long_description: Built with Pygame, this reimagines the classic Chrome dino runner into an endless shooter: jump obstacles and shoot targets to rack up points. A fun take on game loops, input handling, and collision detection.
how_to_use: Install Pygame and run the game. Press spacebar to jump and 's' to shoot — hit targets and avoid obstacles to maximize your score.

title: Etch A Sketch
description: A browser recreation of the classic Etch A Sketch toy, built from scratch in vanilla JavaScript.
long_description: A faithful digital Etch A Sketch — draw across a responsive grid the way you would with the real toy, built with plain JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. A fundamentals project focused on DOM manipulation and interactive UX.
how_to_use: Open the live site and move your cursor across the grid to draw, just like a real Etch A Sketch.

title: JS Calculator
description: A fully functional calculator built in vanilla JavaScript with a clean, responsive UI.
long_description: A classic calculator implemented from scratch in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS — chained operations, a tidy keypad layout, and responsive styling. A foundational frontend project emphasizing clean event handling and UX.
how_to_use: Open the live site and use the keypad to perform calculations directly in your browser.

title: Rock Paper Scissors
description: A browser-based rock-paper-scissors game built in JavaScript — click to play against the computer.
long_description: A simple, snappy rock-paper-scissors game made with JavaScript and a touch of HTML and CSS. Click your move and play instantly in the browser — a clean fundamentals build.
how_to_use: Open the live site and click rock, paper, or scissors to play against the computer.

title: Focus
description: A life-planning app for turning goals into a structured, achievable plan. In active development.
long_description: Focus is a personal project in progress — a planning tool designed to help people organize their goals, time, and priorities into something actionable, rather than another overwhelming to-do list. More details coming soon.

title: DROR
description: A new build in progress — details under wraps for now. Coming soon.
long_description: DROR is a project I'm actively developing. More details will be shared here soon.
